packet-16 -- unverified blind image reading (UTF-8 plain text)

Exposure note: no proposed identification of the work or author was in my context. The overview images themselves show pencilled shelfmark labels on the fragments ("Stams, STA, Frag. 129_1r" ... "_4r"); my background context (user memory index) also mentions a "Stams revisit" in an unrelated project index line, without naming any work. I did not use either for identification.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001, overview of face 1)
- image-001 is a photograph of four separate parchment fragments on black ground, with colour chart and ruler. Pencilled labels: top left "Stams, STA, Frag. 129_3r", top right "..._2r", bottom left "..._4r", bottom right "..._1r".
- All four are in the same kind of small Gothic textualis/semi-cursive bookhand, single column per fragment visible here (fragments are cut from larger leaves; some show the edge of a second column or a gutter/fold).
- Frag. 3r (top left): a vertical fold/crease divides a narrow left strip (end of a column, line-ends only, with red rubric strokes, red paragraph marks, red-touched capitals) from a wider block of ~22 lines with red rubrics/underlining (e.g. red-boxed words "Queritur" at line ends), red paragraph signs, a marginal note in red frame on the right edge, a red flourished initial below the text block. Tentatively: question/response format ("Queritur ... R(esponsio)").
- Frag. 2r (top right): mostly blank/abraded, heavily faded; only a narrow strip at right edge shows line beginnings of a column with a large red initial (O?) at top and red paragraph marks.
- Frag. 4r (bottom left): faded brown ink, ~24 lines in main block, a left strip (another column?) with line-ends, heavy staining.
- Frag. 1r (bottom right): best preserved, ~30 lines main block, left strip with line-ends of another column.
